ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: Payload

sequences.query: (Payload = RGX(".*set.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*mshta.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*vbscript\\:createobject.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*\\\.run.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*\\(window\\\.close\\).*"))
